name: Raene's Cleansing

intro: This task marks the completion of the Rod of Transformation at the hidden shrine in Ashenvale. With the sacred artifact assembled, it must be returned immediately to the dryad Shael'dryn at her moonwell sanctuary.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The rod, now complete, lies in your hands. Shael'dryn will want to hear of your success.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done it, friend! Well done!
